name: Recycling
description: The software project will develop a user-friendly web application that allows users to discover and manage recycling facilities. Key features include searching for nearby centers by zip code, viewing operational hours, accessing maps of recycling locations, and receiving notifications about events. Administrators will manage facility information and user feedback, ensuring data security while enabling communication between facility representatives and site admins to improve community recycling efforts.
rawDescription: The software project will develop a user-friendly web application that allows users to discover and manage recycling facilities. Key features include searching for nearby centers by zip code, viewing operational hours, accessing maps of recycling locations, and receiving notifications about events. Administrators will manage facility information and user feedback, ensuring data security while enabling communication between facility representatives and site admins to improve community recycling efforts.
highLevelGoals: Enable users to easily locate nearby recycling centers by entering a zip code to facilitate convenient access to recycling services.
Provide users with clear and accessible information regarding the operational hours of recycling facilities to plan their visits effectively.
Allow users to visualize the geographic location of recycling centers through integrated maps to aid in navigation and route planning.
Notify users about relevant recycling events to increase community participation and awareness of recycling initiatives.
Allow administrators to create, update, and delete recycling facility records to maintain accurate and up-to-date information for users.
Enable administrators to review and address user feedback to improve the quality of service and user experience.
Ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of user and facility data to maintain trust and comply with security standards.
Allow facility representatives to update their facility's operational details and status to ensure users receive accurate information.
Provide a secure channel for facility representatives to communicate with administrators to resolve issues and improve service delivery.
lowLevelGoals: The system accepts a zip code input from the user and returns a list of recycling facilities within a defined radius.
The system retrieves and displays the specific operational hours (opening/closing times) for a selected recycling facility.
The system generates a map view centered on the coordinates of a selected recycling facility.
The system sends a push notification or email to the user regarding a scheduled recycling event.
The system registers the user's preference to receive notifications for specific recycling events or categories.
The system removes the user's preference to receive notifications for specific recycling events or categories.
The system updates the user's notification preferences, including frequency and specific event types, to customize the delivery of alerts.
The system creates a new record for a recycling facility with specified attributes (name, address, type).
The system modifies existing attributes of a recycling facility record (e.g., address, contact info).
The system removes a recycling facility record from the database.
The system retrieves a list of pending user feedback items for review by the administrator.
The system updates the status of a user feedback item (e.g., resolved, ignored) and optionally adds an admin response.
The system validates the administrator's credentials and issues a secure session token.
The system logs the administrator's access attempts and data modification actions for audit purposes.
The system enforces role-based access control rules to restrict data access and modification permissions for administrators and facility representatives based on their assigned roles.
The system updates the operational status (e.g., open, closed, maintenance) of a specific facility.
The system updates the accepted material types for a specific facility.
The system sends a secure message from the facility representative to the system administrator.

baselineCritiques.actors: The actors are mostly well-defined but lack clarity in some aspects. "User" is too generic and does not capture the specific needs of different user types (e.g., casual users vs. facility representatives). Additionally, the description mentions "Facility Representative," but its role is partially overlapping with "Administrator." It would be better to distinguish between a general "User" and more specific roles like "Casual User" or "Community Member."
baselineCritiques.highLevelGoals: The high-level goals are well-defined, functional, and aligned with the software description. All key features mentioned (searching by zip code, operational hours, maps, notifications) are covered, and the roles of administrators and facility representatives are appropriately addressed. No contradictions or omissions were found.
baselineCritiques.lowLevelGoals: The low-level goals are well-aligned with the high-level goals and actors, covering all necessary functional aspects of the software. However, there is a minor omission in the "Receive Event Notifications" branch where the system should also allow users to set up or customize notification triggers (e.g., types of events they want to be notified about). Additionally, the "Ensure Data Security" branch could benefit from including encryption requirements for sensitive data at rest and in transit. The low-level goals are otherwise comprehensive and correctly represent the software's functionality.
